        f.`School Name` AS SchoolName,

WITH bond_elements AS (
    SELECT
        c.bond_id,
        a1.element AS elem1,
        a2.element AS elem2
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
),
combo_counts AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN elem1 <= elem2 THEN elem1 || '-' || elem2
            ELSE elem2 || '-' || elem1
        END AS combo,
        COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) AS cnt
    FROM bond_elements
    GROUP BY combo
),
max_combo AS (
    SELECT cnt
    FROM combo_counts
    ORDER BY cnt DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
total_bonds AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) AS total
    FROM connected
)
SELECT (max_combo.cnt * 100.0) / total_bonds.total AS percentage
FROM max_combo, total_bonds;	----- bird -----	toxicology

WITH cte_cust AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, Segment
    FROM customers
    WHERE Currency = 'CZK'
),
cte_cons AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Consumption) AS total_cons
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE substr(Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY CustomerID
),
cte_join AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           c.CustomerID,
           COALESCE(cc.total_cons, 0) AS total_cons
    FROM cte_cust c
    LEFT JOIN cte_cons cc ON c.CustomerID = cc.CustomerID
),
cte_min AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_cons) AS min_cons
    FROM cte_join
    GROUP BY Segment
),
cte_lowest AS (
    SELECT j.Segment, j.total_cons
    FROM cte_join j
    JOIN cte_min m
      ON j.Segment = m.Segment
     AND j.total_cons = m.min_cons
),
seg_avg AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           SUM(total_cons) / COUNT(*) AS avg_cons
    FROM cte_lowest
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT 'SME - LAM' AS segment_pair,
       (SELECT avg_cons FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
       (SELECT avg_cons FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS difference
UNION ALL
SELECT 'LAM - KAM',
       (SELECT avg_cons FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
       (SELECT avg_cons FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
UNION ALL

WITH eur_customers AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, Segment
    FROM customers
    WHERE Currency = 'EUR' AND Segment IN ('SME','LAM','KAM')
),
cons_year AS (
    SELECT ec.Segment,
           substr(ym.Date,1,4) AS Year,
           SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM eur_customers ec
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON ec.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE substr(ym.Date,1,4) IN ('2012','2013')
    GROUP BY ec.Segment, substr(ym.Date,1,4)
),
pivot AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           MAX(CASE WHEN Year='2012' THEN TotalConsumption END) AS Cons2012,
           MAX(CASE WHEN Year='2013' THEN TotalConsumption END) AS Cons2013
    FROM cons_year
    GROUP BY Segment
),
pct AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           ((Cons2013 - Cons2012) / Cons2013) * 100.0 AS PctIncrease
    FROM pivot
    WHERE Cons2013 IS NOT NULL AND Cons2012 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT Segment, PctIncrease, 'biggest' AS Type
FROM pct
ORDER BY PctIncrease DESC
LIMIT 1

UNION ALL

SELECT Segment, PctIncrease, 'lowest' AS Type
FROM (
    SELECT Segment, PctIncrease
    FROM pct
    ORDER BY PctIncrease ASC
    LIMIT 1
);	----- bird -----	debit_card_specializing

WITH euro_customers AS (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM customers
    WHERE Currency = 'EUR'
),
yearly_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        ym.CustomerID,
        strftime('%Y', ym.Date) AS Year,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) AS YearTotal
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN euro_customers ec ON ym.CustomerID = ec.CustomerID
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID, Year
),
monthly_avg AS (
    SELECT
        CustomerID,
        Year,
        YearTotal / 12.0 AS MonthlyConsumption
    FROM yearly_consumption
)

FROM monthly_avg;	----- bird -----	debit_card_specializing
